title.en: Florence, workshops and a Medici design
title.zh: 佛罗伦萨、工坊与美第奇设计

alt.en: Fishermen haul nets across a river beneath bridges and Florence’s towers and cathedral dome; a reclining bearded river god fills the foreground.
alt.zh: 渔民在桥梁、佛罗伦萨高塔及主教座堂穹顶下的河面拉网；前景是一位斜倚的有须河神。

caption.en: Stradanus, The Arno with Fishermen, 1580–1596. Ink, washes and white gouache on gray paper; Getty 83.GG.380. Florence’s cathedral, campanile and Palazzo Vecchio appear in a design probably connected to a Medici tapestry commission.
caption.zh: 斯特拉达努斯，《阿尔诺河上的渔民》，1580—1596年。灰纸上墨、水洗色与白色水粉；盖蒂83.GG.380。画中可见佛罗伦萨主教座堂、钟楼及旧宫；此设计可能与美第奇家族的挂毯委托有关。

interpretation.en: Florence’s monuments frame fishermen and an allegorical river god. Stradanus probably designed the scene for a Medici tapestry commission. He cut out and replaced the lower centre of the drawing, adding fishermen and the reclining god.
interpretation.zh: 佛罗伦萨的古迹环绕着渔民与寓意性的河神。斯特拉达努斯可能为美第奇挂毯委托绘制此图；他曾剪去并替换下方中央部分，增添渔民与斜倚的河神。

title.en: A medieval image of Paul’s letters
title.zh: 保罗书信的中世纪图像

alt.en: Two columns of Latin writing surround blue and gold initials; the upper initial shows a haloed man handing a scroll toward two figures, while a monk writes below.
alt.zh: 两栏拉丁文围绕蓝金色首字母；上方首字母中有光环的男子向两人递交卷轴，下方则有修士书写。

caption.en: Unknown illuminator, Initial P: Saint Paul; Initial P: A Bishop Giving a Letter to a Messenger, about 1280–1290, Bologna. Tempera, gold leaf and ink; Getty Ms. Ludwig I 11, fol. 501. Getty identifies the upper scene with Paul’s letter to the Philippians.
caption.zh: 佚名彩饰师，《首字母P：圣保罗；首字母P：主教向信使递交书信》，约1280—1290年，博洛尼亚。蛋彩、金箔与墨；盖蒂路德维希手稿I 11，第501叶。盖蒂将上方场景与保罗致腓立比人的书信联系起来。

interpretation.en: This medieval page shows Paul passing a letter to a messenger, with a bishop looking on. It depicts the letter to the Philippians, rather than Corinthians, and reveals how a Bolognese monastic community pictured the ancient writer more than twelve centuries later.
interpretation.zh: 这页中世纪手稿描绘保罗把书信递给信使，旁有主教观看。画中是致腓立比人的书信，而非致哥林多人的书信；它展现逾十二个世纪后，博洛尼亚修道团体如何想象这位古代作者。

title.en: A canon-law textbook and its readers

alt.en: A parchment page has two columns of Latin text, marginal notes and a blue initial containing an enthroned bishop flanked by two figures.
alt.zh: 羊皮纸页上有两栏拉丁文、页边注释及蓝色首字母；字母中主教端坐，两侧各有一人。

caption.en: Unknown French illuminator, Initial D: A Bishop Enthroned with Two Plaintiffs, from Gratian’s Decretum, about 1170–1180. Paris or Sens; Getty Ms. Ludwig XIV 2, fol. 97v. Tempera, gold leaf and ink.
caption.zh: 法国佚名彩饰师，《首字母D：端坐的主教与两位诉讼当事人》，出自格拉提安《教令集》，约1170—1180年。巴黎或桑斯；盖蒂路德维希手稿XIV 2，第97叶背面。蛋彩、金箔与墨。

interpretation.en: Gratian’s canon-law compilation, connected with teaching in Bologna, became a university textbook across Europe. This French copy preserves the text, a legal scene and readers’ marginal annotations, showing the working materials of medieval legal study.
interpretation.zh: 格拉提安的教会法汇编与博洛尼亚教学相关，后来成为欧洲大学课本。这部法国抄本保留正文、法律场景与读者页边批注，呈现中世纪法律学习的实物材料。

title.en: Isabella remembered in a cathedral commission
title.zh: 主教座堂委托中的伊莎贝拉纪念像

alt.en: A queen kneels with hands joined beside a cushion and crown, above an ornate bracket with an empty shield, armor and flags; a scale runs down the right edge.
alt.zh: 王后双手合十跪于软垫与王冠旁，下方饰架有空盾、盔甲和旗帜；右侧边缘标有比例尺。

caption.en: Pedro Mena y Medrano, Study for a Statue of Queen Isabella, 1673–1674. Pen and gray ink and watercolor over black chalk; Getty 94.GA.82. Design for Granada Cathedral, paired with a statue of Ferdinand II of Aragon.
caption.zh: 佩德罗·梅纳·伊·梅德拉诺，《伊莎贝拉王后雕像习作》，1673—1674年。黑粉笔底稿上灰墨与水彩；盖蒂94.GA.82。为格拉纳达主教座堂而设计，与阿拉贡斐迪南二世雕像成对。

interpretation.en: Made roughly two centuries after Isabella’s rule, the design pairs her with Ferdinand in Granada Cathedral. Her kneeling pose presents a devout monarch; the scale and shaded bracket guide the sculptor in turning this drawing into a commemorative statue.
interpretation.zh: 此设计晚于伊莎贝拉统治约两世纪，在格拉纳达主教座堂与斐迪南像成对。跪姿表现虔诚君主，比例尺与饰架阴影则帮助雕刻者把画稿转为纪念雕像。

items.credit: J. Paul Getty Museum, Los Angeles; 94.GA.82
